review.why: The PR removes the explicit 404 check for missing posts in DELETE /posts/<id>, causing a 500 Internal Server Error when trying to delete a non-existent post instead of the documented 404 response, because accessing post.author on None raises an AttributeError.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: Removing the explicit 404 check causes db.session.get to return None, then accessing post.author raises AttributeError which becomes a 500 error instead of the intended 404.

doppel_guided.summary: The PR introduces a regression where deleting a missing post returns 500 instead of 404 because the None check was removed without adding a proper 404 handler.
